limitations: Historical attempts without question snapshots use current question data and retain saved overall verdicts.
Topics with fewer than five practice families open the original saved answer instead of unrelated practice.
Unofficial explanations remain explicitly incomplete where source-specific explanations are unavailable.

historyNavigation.changes: Past exams question/history tabs, per-exam history links, newest-first history and answer return navigation.
historyNavigation.validationPolicy: Exact-head verify and Pages production checks required.

limitations: No official answer key or official score model was supplied; app answers are independent and non-official.
Listening audio/transcripts not supplied are not graded and do not count as wrong.
Omitted FY24/FY25 source sections are not reconstructed.
Four free-story tasks and five source-reviewed reading short answers receive unofficial AI feedback. Unsupported source sections and unmatched practice remain excluded from AI grading.
FY26B task/feedback remain hidden until final exam completion is recorded; paper completion is a learner declaration, not server-authenticated exam evidence.
Unmatched short-answer practice uses explicit learner self-review; it is not automatic semantic grading.
